# YWCA Women of Achievement

Members of the HCSO Command Staff joined Sheriff Charmaine McGuffey as she was honored as a 2023 YWCA Career Woman of Achievement at a splendid luncheon in downtown Cincinnati on May 10th, 2023

We are extremely proud of Sheriff McGuffey and this well-deserved accomplishment. Thank you to all who shared well wishes and congratulations!
